_comment: Feature map fragment for the container-based observability e2e harness (logging / metrics / tracing). Merged with the other harnesses' fragments by internal/acceptance/scripts/generate-summary.mjs into one Feature Coverage table. File keys are relative to this harness's Playwright testDir (./tests).

Logging.description: Access and authorize log field configuration driven through a real browser sign-in on an allow_any_authenticated_user route: built-in defaults, custom field lists, headers.<Name> fields, and the authenticate/authorize decision trail

Metrics.description: metrics_address listener with the aggregated /metrics path, the raw (and basic-auth-exempt) /metrics/envoy path, and metrics_basic_auth including load-time rejection of malformed values

metrics.spec.ts: Malformed Basic Auth Rejected at Load

Tracing.description: OTEL tracing enablement matrix (exporter + endpoint, OTEL_SDK_DISABLED), Envoy+Pomerium trace correlation against a real Jaeger collector, and otel_traces_sampler_arg sampling/clamping
